title: Your First Weekend at Bentley University, Shared as Cards
description: A guide to the essential sequence of events and campus landmarks for new Falcons during their first weekend in Waltham.

cards.title: Arrive for Move-In
cards.subtitle: The First Stop for New Falcons
cards.notes: Start your journey at the Miller Parking Garage for check-in. Follow the staggered arrival times to ensure a smooth transition into your residence hall.
cards.short_summary: The primary check-in and arrival point for new students moving into Bentley residence halls.
cards.evidence_claim: New students are directed to the upper level of the Miller Parking Garage as their first stop for move-in and screening.
cards.source_title: Parents and Families Orientation - Waltham - Bentley University
cards.access_notes: Access is restricted to students with assigned move-in time slots during orientation weekend.

cards.title: Attend University Convocation
cards.subtitle: The Official Academic Start
cards.notes: Join your class for this formal ceremony where faculty in regalia welcome you. It marks the official beginning of your academic career as a Falcon.
cards.short_summary: A traditional ceremony held during orientation to officially welcome the new undergraduate class.
cards.evidence_claim: University Convocation is a Bentley tradition that marks the official start to the academic year for new students.
cards.access_notes: Required for all new undergraduate students; families are invited to attend.

cards.title: First Meal at The 921
cards.subtitle: Main Campus Dining Hall
cards.notes: Head to the Student Center for your first all-you-care-to-eat meal. It's the central hub for meeting floor-mates over breakfast or dinner.
cards.short_summary: Bentley's primary all-you-care-to-eat dining facility located within the Student Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Student Center is home to the 921 Dining Hall, Bentley's all-you-care-to-eat dining facility.
cards.access_notes: Open daily during the academic year; check the Falcon Dining website for specific weekend hours.

cards.title: Relax in the Student Center
cards.subtitle: Billiards and Community Space
cards.notes: Take a break from unpacking to play a game of pool or relax in the 'Living Room' area. It's a great low-pressure way to meet other new students.
cards.short_summary: A social space in the Student Center featuring pool tables and lounge areas for student relaxation.
cards.evidence_claim: Students can relax and play pool or seek out quiet spaces within the Student Center.
cards.access_notes: Open to all students; game equipment can be rented at the 3rd-floor Business Center.

cards.title: Explore the Fitness Center
cards.subtitle: Campus Recreation Hub
cards.notes: Visit the 10,000-square foot fitness room to see the cardio and weight equipment. It's a popular spot for students to stay active between orientation events.
cards.short_summary: The main athletic facility on campus featuring a fitness center, pool, and basketball courts.
cards.evidence_claim: The Dana Athletic Center features a 10,000-square foot fitness/weight room for students.
cards.access_notes: Requires a valid Bentley ID for access; typically open 10:00 AM to 10:00 PM daily.

cards.title: Find Your Study Spot
cards.subtitle: Academic Resource Center
cards.notes: Walk through the library to find the group study rooms and 'Hush Pods.' Locating your preferred quiet zone early helps for the first week of classes.
cards.short_summary: The university's main library offering diverse study environments from collaborative rooms to quiet zones.
cards.evidence_claim: Bentley Library offers a variety of study spaces including 22 collaborative study rooms and soundproof HUSH pods.
cards.access_notes: Open Sunday 10:00 AM–12:00 AM; check website for specific orientation weekend hours.

cards.title: Ride the Shuttle to Cambridge
cards.subtitle: Off-Campus Exploration
cards.notes: Catch the shuttle from the LaCava Center to Harvard Square. It's a free way to explore the local area and access the MBTA Red Line into Boston.
cards.short_summary: A university-provided shuttle service connecting the Bentley campus to Harvard Square in Cambridge.
cards.evidence_claim: The Harvard Shuttle departs Bentley on the half-hour and provides access to Cambridge and MBTA services.
cards.source_title: Shuttle Routes and Schedules - Bentley University
cards.access_notes: Weekend service typically starts at 10:30 AM from Bentley; valid student ID may be required.

cards.title: Explore Moody Street
cards.subtitle: Local Waltham Shuttle
cards.notes: Use the Falcon Flyer shuttle to visit Moody Street's shops and restaurants. It's the easiest way to get to the grocery store or local cafes.
cards.short_summary: A shuttle route serving the Waltham area, including Moody Street and the Commuter Rail station.
cards.evidence_claim: The Falcon Flyer provides access to Moody St shops, restaurants, and Hannaford's Supermarket.
cards.access_notes: Saturday service runs from 10:45 AM to 11:47 PM; Sunday service ends at 10:17 PM.

cards.title: Visit the Bentley Arena
cards.subtitle: Home of Falcon Hockey
cards.notes: Check out the LEED Platinum-certified ice arena. Even if there isn't a game, it's a landmark building where students gather for major events.
cards.short_summary: A state-of-the-art ice arena that hosts Bentley's Division I hockey program and campus events.
cards.evidence_claim: The Bentley Arena is the first standalone ice arena in the country to receive LEED platinum certification.
cards.access_notes: Open for scheduled events and games; check the athletics calendar for weekend activities.

cards.title: Join a Student Organization
cards.subtitle: Get Involved on Campus
cards.notes: Look for the bi-annual Activities Fair usually held early in the semester. It's the best time to explore over 100 clubs and find your community.
cards.short_summary: An event where student organizations showcase their activities to recruit new members.
cards.evidence_claim: Bentley has over 100 clubs and organizations and the bi-annual Activities Fair highlights them all.
cards.access_notes: Typically held in the Student Center or on the campus green; check orientation schedule for exact timing.
